en.longDescription:
Take control of your equipment. Ensure user safety. Onix Tool Store gives you full control over your tools. Manage check-in and check-out of your equipment to ensure it is always available, safe and ready to use.

Note that due to numerous Winget bugs related to dependency architectures, this Winget package can only be installed on Windows 10 x86.
